concerns.text: Task T012 is too coarse. It bundles optical flow extraction, HOG density calculation, error handling for missing audio, and file I/O into a single task. The 'ATOMIZE: requested' comment indicates this is known. Split into: T012a (Optical Flow extraction), T012b (HOG density), T012c (Error handling logic).

Task T013 is too coarse. It bundles spectral centroid, zero-crossing rate, missing audio handling, and file I/O. Split into: T013a (Spectral Centroid), T013b (Zero-Crossing Rate), T013c (Missing audio handling).

Task T015 is too coarse. It combines Ridge, Lasso, and XGBoost training into one task. These are distinct algorithms with different hyperparameters and output files. Split into: T015a (Ridge/Lasso training), T015b (XGBoost training).

Task T016 is too coarse. It combines Pearson correlation, Spearman correlation, and bootstrapping logic. While often in one function, for atomic execution, split into: T016a (Point estimate correlations), T016b (Bootstrapping for CIs).
Task T022 is too coarse. It mixes batch processing logic, timing aggregation, and JSON output generation. Split into: T022a (Batch processing loop), T022b (Timing aggregation logic).
Task T034 is too coarse. It requires scanning all scripts, verifying seeds, and generating a validation report. Split into: T034a (Seed scanning logic), T034b (Validation report generation).

Task T035 is too coarse. It requires scanning for GPU imports AND running the pipeline on a CPU-only runner. These are two distinct verification steps. Split into: T035a (Static import scan), T035b (Runtime CPU execution test).
